local function main(D)
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RunService=game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting=game:GetService("Lighting")

local lp=Players.LocalPlayer
local file="RobAnimator.lua"
local assetFile="RaidenAssets_v1.rbxm"

if not isfile(file) then
	writefile(file,game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ian49972/Animator/refs/heads/main/RobAnimator"))
end
if not getgenv().AdvancedKeyframePlayerLoaded then
	loadstring(readfile(file))()
end
local Play=getgenv().PlayKeyframeSequence

if getgenv().RaidenCleanup then
	pcall(getgenv().RaidenCleanup)
end

local function decode(parts)
	local s=table.concat(parts)
	local fns={
		crypt and crypt.base64decode or false,
		crypt and crypt.base64 and crypt.base64.decode or false,
		base64_decode or false,
		base64decode or false,
		base64 and base64.decode or false,
	}
	for i=1,#fns do
		local f=fns[i]
		if f then
			local ok,r=pcall(f,s)
			if ok and type(r)=="string" and r:sub(1,8)=="<roblox!" then return r end
		end
	end
	local alpha="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
	local map={}
	for i=1,64 do map[alpha:byte(i)]=i-1 end
	local out={}
	for ci,c in ipairs(parts) do
		local t={}
		for i=1,#c,4 do
			local a,b,c2,d=c:byte(i,i+3)
			local x=map[a]*262144+map[b]*4096+(map[c2] or 0)*64+(map[d] or 0)
			local g=string.char(math.floor(x/65536)%256,math.floor(x/256)%256,x%256)
			if d==61 then g=g:sub(1,c2==61 and 1 or 2) end
			t[#t+1]=g
		end
		out[ci]=table.concat(t)
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

if not isfile(assetFile) then
	writefile(assetFile,decode(D))
end

local Data=Instance.new("Folder")
Data.Name="RaidenData"
for _,o in ipairs(game:GetObjects((getcustomasset or getsynasset)(assetFile))) do
	o.Parent=Data
end

local W=workspace
local R=Data:WaitForChild("system_40277")
local anims=R:WaitForChild("AnimSaves")
local camSrc=Data:WaitForChild("CameraController")
local camAnims=camSrc:WaitForChild("AnimSaves")
local camWeldSrc=camSrc.Main:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Motor6D")

local conns={}
local function bind(c)
	conns[#conns+1]=c
	return c
end

for _,n in ipairs({"RaidenCC","RaidenBlur"}) do
	local o=Lighting:FindFirstChild(n)
	if o then o:Destroy() end
end

local cc=Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
cc.Name="RaidenCC"
cc.Parent=Lighting
local bl=Instance.new("BlurEffect")
bl.Name="RaidenBlur"
bl.Size=0
bl.Parent=Lighting

local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name="RaidenUI"
gui.IgnoreGuiInset=true
gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
gui.DisplayOrder=100
gui.Parent=(gethui and gethui()) or lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local function makeBar(top)
	local f=Instance.new("Frame")
	f.BackgroundColor3=Color3.new(0,0,0)
	f.BorderSizePixel=0
	f.Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
	f.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0,top and 0 or 1)
	f.Position=UDim2.new(0,0,top and 0 or 1,0)
	f.Parent=gui
	return f
end
local topBar,botBar=makeBar(true),makeBar(false)

local title=Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.BackgroundTransparency=1
title.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(0.5,0)
title.Position=UDim2.new(0.5,0,0.13,0)
title.Size=UDim2.new(0.6,0,0,30)
title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
title.TextSize=22
title.TextTransparency=1
title.TextStrokeTransparency=1
title.Text=""
title.Parent=gui

local function flash(col,dur,blur,bright)
	cc.TintColor=col
	cc.Brightness=bright or 0.6
	TweenService:Create(cc,TweenInfo.new(dur,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad),{Brightness=0,TintColor=Color3.new(1,1,1)}):Play()
	bl.Size=blur or 20
	TweenService:Create(bl,TweenInfo.new(dur),{Size=0}):Play()
end

local function pulse(root)
	if not root then return end
	for _,d in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			local delay=d:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") or 0
			local count=d:GetAttribute("EmitCount") or 8
			local dur=d:GetAttribute("EmitDuration")
			task.delay(delay,function()
				if dur then
					d.Enabled=true
					task.delay(dur,function() d.Enabled=false end)
				else
					d:Emit(count)
				end
			end)
		elseif d:IsA("Beam") then
			local w0,w1=d:GetAttribute("Width0_End"),d:GetAttribute("Width1_End")
			local dur=d:GetAttribute("EffectDuration") or 0.6
			d.Enabled=true
			if w0 or w1 then
				TweenService:Create(d,TweenInfo.new(dur,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{Width0=w0 or d.Width0,Width1=w1 or d.Width1}):Play()
			end
			task.delay(dur,function() d.Enabled=false end)
		end
	end
end

local function burst(parent,color,count)
	local e=Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
	e.Texture="rbxasset://textures/particles/sparkles_main.dds"
	e.Color=ColorSequence.new(color)
	e.LightEmission=0.4
	e.Rate=0
	e.Lifetime=NumberRange.new(0.4,0.9)
	e.Speed=NumberRange.new(20,45)
	e.SpreadAngle=Vector2.new(360,360)
	e.Size=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,1.2),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,0)})
	e.Transparency=NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0,0),NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1,1)})
	e.Drag=3
	e.Parent=parent
	e:Emit(count)
	task.delay(1.5,function() e:Destroy() end)
end

local function reset(model)
	if not model then return end
	for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") then d.Transform=CFrame.new() end
	end
end

local cache=setmetatable({},{__mode="k"})
local function getTrack(model,seq)
	if not model or not seq then return nil end
	local m=cache[model]
	if not m then
		m={}
		cache[model]=m
	end
	local t=m[seq]
	if not t then
		t=Play(model,seq)
		m[seq]=t
	end
	return t
end

local function startTrack(t,looped)
	if not t then return end
	t.Looped=looped
	t:Stop()
	t.TimePosition=0
	t:Play(1)
end

local function pickVictims(n)
	local pool={}
	local hrp=lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hrp then return pool end
	for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local c=p~=lp and p.Character
		local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local r=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if h and r and h.Health>0 and h.RigType==Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and (r.Position-hrp.Position).Magnitude<=50 then
			pool[#pool+1]=c
		end
	end
	for i=#pool,2,-1 do
		local j=math.random(i)
		pool[i],pool[j]=pool[j],pool[i]
	end
	local out={}
	for i=1,math.min(n,#pool) do out[i]=pool[i] end
	return out
end

	{title="",rig="intro",cam="intro cam",victims={{"system_40277 og","intro victim 1"},{"Yhnbhbhg","intro victim 2"},{"moltenbeasts","intro victim 3"}},events=function(c)
		c.at(3.9,function() c.pulse("IntroVFX","Lens") flash(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.6,8,0.3) end)

		c.at(11.2,function() c.limb(true) end)

		c.at(2.1,function()
			c.blood()
			flash(Color3.fromRGB(255,60,70),0.4,6,0.25)
			c.shake(0.6)
		end)
	end},
	{title="FINISHER",color=Color3.fromRGB(255,40,90),rig="finisher",cam="finisher cam",victims={{"TemplateR6","finisher vic"}},events=function(c)
		c.at(0.2,function() c.limb(true) c.follow("FinisherVFX","LightningSteps",2.2) end)
		c.at(0.3,function() c.pulse("FinisherVFX","WindFinisher") end)
		c.at(2.4,function() c.limb(false) c.pulse("FinisherVFX","WindKickUp1") c.shake(0.5) end)

		c.at(4.4,function() c.pulse("FinisherVFX","Kick") c.pulse("FinisherVFX","Kicks") flash(Color3.new(1,1,1),0.7,16,0.9) c.shake(1.5) end)
		c.at(4.8,function() c.pulse("FinisherVFX","MainImpactWall") c.shake(2) end)

		c.at(0.2,function() c.pulse("OutroVFX","WindOutro") end)
		c.at(0.8,function() c.pulse("OutroVFX","WinDebrisUp") end)
		c.at(2.0,function() c.pulse("OutroVFX","WindAr") end)
		c.at(3.1,function()
			TweenService:Create(cc,TweenInfo.new(0.5),{TintColor=Color3.fromRGB(255,70,80),Contrast=0.25,Saturation=0.3}):Play()
		end)
	end},
}

local tool=nil
local char,hum,hrp=nil,nil,nil
local equipped=false
local busy=false
local idx=0
local dressed={}
local limbObjs={}
local trailObjs={}
local locoConn=nil
local current=nil

local function remap(a)
	if not a then return nil end
	if char and a:IsDescendantOf(char) then return a end
	local p=a.Parent
	local tp=p and char and char:FindFirstChild(p.Name,true)
	return (tp and tp:FindFirstChild(a.Name)) or a
end

local function solid(model)
	for _,d in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("BasePart") then
			d.Anchored=false
			d.CanCollide=false
			d.CanQuery=false
			d.CanTouch=false
			d.Massless=true
		end
	end
end

local function dress()
	dressed={}
	limbObjs={}
	trailObjs={}
	local ra,tor=char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"),char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	local swS,shS=R:FindFirstChild("Murasama"),R:FindFirstChild("Sheath")
	for _,n in ipairs({"Head","Left Arm","Left Leg","Right Arm","Right Leg","Torso"}) do
		local sp,tp=R:FindFirstChild(n),char:FindFirstChild(n)
		if sp and tp then
			for _,c in ipairs(sp:GetChildren()) do
				if c:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or c:IsA("Trail") or c:IsA("Beam") or (c:IsA("Attachment") and not tp:FindFirstChild(c.Name)) then
					local k=c:Clone()
					k.Parent=tp
					dressed[#dressed+1]=k
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function attach(src,part,jointName,p0,srcJoint)
		if not src or not p0 then return end
		local m=src:Clone()
		m.Parent=char
		solid(m)
		dressed[#dressed+1]=m
		local h=m:FindFirstChild(part)
		if h and srcJoint then
			local j=Instance.new("Motor6D")
			j.Name=jointName
			j.Part0=p0
			j.Part1=h
			j.C0=srcJoint.C0
			j.C1=srcJoint.C1
			j.Parent=p0
			dressed[#dressed+1]=j
		end
	end
	attach(swS,"Handle","Handle",ra,ra and R["Right Arm"]:FindFirstChild("Handle"))
	attach(shS,"Handle2","Handle2",tor,tor and R.Torso:FindFirstChild("Handle2"))
	for _,d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if d:IsA("Trail") or d:IsA("Beam") then
			d.Attachment0=remap(d.Attachment0)
			d.Attachment1=remap(d.Attachment1)
			if d:IsA("Trail") then
				d.Enabled=false
				trailObjs[#trailObjs+1]=d
			end
		end
	end
	for _,k in ipairs(dressed) do
		if k:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			k.Enabled=false
			limbObjs[#limbObjs+1]=k
		else
			for _,e in ipairs(k:GetDescendants()) do
				if e:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
					e.Enabled=false
					limbObjs[#limbObjs+1]=e
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function undress()
	for _,k in ipairs(dressed) do
		if k and k.Parent then k:Destroy() end
	end
	dressed={}
	limbObjs={}
	trailObjs={}
end

local function limb(on)
	for _,e in ipairs(limbObjs) do
		if e.Parent then e.Enabled=on end
	end
end

local function trails(on)
	for _,t in ipairs(trailObjs) do
		if t.Parent then t.Enabled=on end
	end
end

local function setLoco(key)
	if current==key then return end
	local m=cache[char]
	if current and m then
		local old=anims:FindFirstChild(current)
		local ot=old and m[old]
		if ot then ot:Stop() end
	end
	current=key
	if key then
		local t=getTrack(char,anims:FindFirstChild(key))
		if t then
			t.Looped=true
			t:Play(1)
		end
	end
end

local function stopAll(model)
	local m=cache[model]
	if m then
		for _,t in pairs(m) do t:Stop() end
	end
end

local function runScene(s)
	if not char or not hum or not hrp or hum.RigType~=Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then return end
	busy=true
	setLoco(nil)
	local cam=W.CurrentCamera
	local offset=hrp.CFrame*R.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame:Inverse()
	local prevAnch=hrp.Anchored
	hrp.Anchored=true

	local folders={}
	local function folder(n)
		if folders[n] then return folders[n] end
		local src=Data:FindFirstChild(n)
		if not src then return nil end
		local f=src:Clone()
		for _,d in ipairs(f:GetDescendants()) do
			if d:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or d:IsA("Beam") or d:IsA("Trail") then
				d.Enabled=false
			elseif d:IsA("BasePart") then
				d.Anchored=true
				d.CanCollide=false
				d.CanQuery=false
				d.CanTouch=false
				d.CFrame=offset*d.CFrame
			end
		end
		f.Parent=W
		folders[n]=f
		return f
	end

	local camModel=Instance.new("Model")
	camModel.Name="RaidenCam"
	local main=Instance.new("Part")
	main.Name="Main"
	main.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1)
	main.Transparency=1
	main.Anchored=true
	main.CanCollide=false
	main.CanQuery=false
	main.CanTouch=false
	main.CFrame=camSrc.Main.CFrame
	main.Parent=camModel
	local cp=Instance.new("Part")
	cp.Name="CameraPart"
	cp.Size=Vector3.new(1,1,1)
	cp.Transparency=1
	cp.Massless=true
	cp.CanCollide=false
	cp.CanQuery=false
	cp.CanTouch=false
	cp.CFrame=camSrc.CameraPart.CFrame
	cp.Parent=camModel
	local weld=Instance.new("Motor6D")
	weld.Name="CameraWeld"
	weld.Part0=main
	weld.Part1=cp
	weld.C0=camWeldSrc.C0
	weld.C1=camWeldSrc.C1
	weld.Parent=main
	camModel.Parent=W

	local vlist={}
	local vics=pickVictims(#s.victims)
	for i,v in ipairs(vics) do
		local spec=s.victims[i]
		local rig=Data:FindFirstChild(spec[1])
		local saves=rig and rig:FindFirstChild("AnimSaves")
		local vk=saves and saves:FindFirstChild(spec[2])
		local vh=v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if vk and vh then
			vlist[#vlist+1]={char=v,hrp=vh,cf=rig.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame,anch=vh.Anchored,track=getTrack(v,vk)}
			vh.Anchored=true
		end
	end

	local mainTrack=getTrack(char,anims:FindFirstChild(s.rig))
	local camTrack=getTrack(camModel,camAnims:FindFirstChild(s.cam))
	local len=(mainTrack and mainTrack.Length) or 5

	local oldType,oldFov,oldSubject=cam.CameraType,cam.FieldOfView,cam.CameraSubject
	cam.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local shk=0
	local follows={}

	local render=RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local cf=main.CFrame*weld.C0*weld.Transform*weld.C1:Inverse()
		cam.CFrame=offset*cf
		if shk>0.001 then
			cam.CFrame=cam.CFrame*CFrame.new((math.random()-0.5)*shk,(math.random()-0.5)*shk,0)
			shk=shk*0.9
		end
		for _,v in ipairs(vlist) do
			if v.hrp.Parent then v.hrp.CFrame=offset*v.cf end
		end
		local tor=char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
		for p,until_ in pairs(follows) do
			if os.clock()>until_ or not tor then
				follows[p]=nil
			else
				p.CFrame=tor.CFrame*CFrame.new(0,-2.5,0)
			end
		end
	end)

	TweenService:Create(topBar,TweenInfo.new(0.4),{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0.11,0)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(botBar,TweenInfo.new(0.4),{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0.11,0)}):Play()
	if s.title~="" then
		title.Text=s.title
		title.TextColor3=s.color or Color3.new(1,1,1)
		TweenService:Create(title,TweenInfo.new(0.4),{TextTransparency=0}):Play()
	end

	trails(true)

	local c={}
	c.at=function(t,fn) task.delay(t,function() if busy then pcall(fn) end end) end
	c.pulse=function(f,n)
		local fo=folder(f)
		pulse(fo and fo:FindFirstChild(n))
	end
	c.limb=limb
	c.shake=function(a) shk=a end
	c.follow=function(f,n,dur)
		local fo=folder(f)
		local p=fo and fo:FindFirstChild(n)
		if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
			follows[p]=os.clock()+dur
			pulse(p)
			for i=1,math.floor(dur/0.12) do
				task.delay(i*0.12,function() if p.Parent then pulse(p) end end)
			end
		end
	end
	c.blood=function()
		local target=(vlist[1] and vlist[1].char:FindFirstChild("Torso")) or hrp
		burst(target,Color3.fromRGB(190,10,20),40)
	end

	startTrack(mainTrack,false)
	startTrack(camTrack,false)
	for _,v in ipairs(vlist) do startTrack(v.track,false) end
	s.events(c)

	task.wait(len+0.4)

	flash(Color3.new(0,0,0),0.4,0,0)
	render:Disconnect()
	cam.CameraType=oldType
	cam.FieldOfView=oldFov
	cam.CameraSubject=hum
	TweenService:Create(topBar,TweenInfo.new(0.4),{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(botBar,TweenInfo.new(0.4),{Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(title,TweenInfo.new(0.4),{TextTransparency=1}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(cc,TweenInfo.new(0.5),{TintColor=Color3.new(1,1,1),Contrast=0,Saturation=0,Brightness=0}):Play()
	trails(false)
	limb(false)
	stopAll(camModel)
	camModel:Destroy()
	for _,v in ipairs(vlist) do
		if v.track then v.track:Stop() end
		if v.char.Parent then
			reset(v.char)
			v.hrp.Anchored=v.anch
			local vh=v.char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if vh and not vh:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") then
				Instance.new("Animator",vh)
			end
		end
	end
	if mainTrack then mainTrack:Stop() end
	hrp.Anchored=prevAnch
	reset(char)
	for _,f in pairs(folders) do
		task.delay(3,function() f:Destroy() end)
	end
	busy=false
end

local function equip()
	char=lp.Character
	hum=char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	hrp=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not hum or not hrp or hum.RigType~=Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then return end
	equipped=true
	current=nil
	local an=char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
	if an then an.Disabled=true end
	dress()
	locoConn=RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if busy or not equipped or not hrp or not hrp.Parent then return end
		local v=hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local sp=Vector3.new(v.X,0,v.Z).Magnitude
		local key=sp<1 and "Idle" or (sp<22 and "walk" or "run")
		setLoco(key)
		local m=cache[char]
		local sq=m and anims:FindFirstChild(key) and m[anims[key]]
		if sq and key~="Idle" then
			sq.Speed=math.clamp(sp/(key=="walk" and 14 or 26),0.5,1.8)
		end
	end)
end

local function unequip()
	equipped=false
	if locoConn then
		locoConn:Disconnect()
		locoConn=nil
	end
	if char then
		stopAll(char)
		reset(char)
		undress()
		local an=char:FindFirstChild("Animate")
		if an then an.Disabled=false end
		local h=char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if h and not h:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") then
			Instance.new("Animator",h)
		end
	end
	current=nil
end

local function makeTool()
	for _,p in ipairs({lp:FindFirstChild("Backpack"),lp.Character}) do
		if p then
			local o=p:FindFirstChild("Raiden")
			if o then o:Destroy() end
		end
	end
	tool=Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name="Raiden"
	tool.RequiresHandle=false
	tool.CanBeDropped=false
	bind(tool.Equipped:Connect(equip))
	bind(tool.Unequipped:Connect(unequip))
	bind(tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		if busy or not equipped then return end
		idx=idx%#scenes+1
		task.spawn(runScene,scenes[idx])
	end))
	tool.Parent=lp:WaitForChild("Backpack")
end

makeTool()
bind(lp.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	busy=false
	equipped=false
	idx=0
	task.wait(0.6)
	makeTool()
end))

getgenv().RaidenCleanup=function()
	for _,c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	if locoConn then locoConn:Disconnect() end
	if tool then tool:Destroy() end
	gui:Destroy()
	Data:Destroy()
	cc:Destroy()
	bl:Destroy()
end
end
